description: A singleton helper class for managing shared preferences in a Flutter app, providing methods for initialization, reading, writing, and clearing preferences.

classes.name: PreferenceHelper
classes.description: A singleton class providing static methods to initialize and interact with SharedPreferences for storing key-value pairs.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the SharedPreferences instance. Must be called before any read or write operations.

methods.name: writeInt
methods.description: Stores an integer value associated with a key.

methods.name: writeBool
methods.description: Stores a boolean value associated with a key.

methods.name: writeString
methods.description: Stores a string value associated with a key.

methods.name: getInt
methods.description: Retrieves an integer value for a given key, defaulting to 0 if not set.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Retrieves a string value for a given key, defaulting to 'en' if not set.

methods.name: getBool
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean value for a given key, defaulting to true or a provided defaultValue.

methods.name: getLoginBool
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean indicating login status, defaulting to false.
